lines.zh: 我四脚着地，背却比草高。
lines.en: I walk on four feet, my back taller than the grass.

lines.zh: 长尾巴在我身后拖出一条线。
lines.en: My long tail drags a line behind me.

lines.zh: 我走过平原，麦子擦着肚皮。
lines.en: I cross the plains with wheat brushing my belly.

lines.zh: 恶地的碎石在我脚下响。
lines.en: Badlands gravel clicks under my feet.

lines.zh: 我的步子轻，影子却拉得很长。
lines.en: My steps are light, but my shadow stretches long.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴扫开前面的草。
lines.en: I sweep the grass ahead aside with my tail.

lines.zh: 胡须先探路，我才跟上。
lines.en: My whiskers test the way before I follow.

lines.zh: 我沿着田埂走，避开翻过的土。
lines.en: I walk the field ridge, avoiding the turned soil.

lines.zh: 风把我的毛吹得贴住身体。
lines.en: The wind flattens my fur against my body.

lines.zh: 我每走三步，就停一次嗅土。
lines.en: Every three steps I stop and sniff the soil.

lines.zh: 细长的腿迈得很高，像跨沟。
lines.en: My thin legs step high as if crossing a ditch.

lines.zh: 我从麦子中间穿过，麦穗乱晃。
lines.en: I pass through the wheat and the ears sway.

lines.zh: 我坐在后腿上，把尾巴盘起来。
lines.en: I sit on my haunches and coil my tail.

lines.zh: 我舔前爪，一根一根地舔。
lines.en: I lick my forepaws, one finger at a time.

lines.zh: 田里没有人，我听见虫在响。
lines.en: No one in the field; I hear the insects.

lines.zh: 我竖起耳朵，转了个方向。
lines.en: I prick my ears and turn them.

lines.zh: 太阳把我背上的毛晒得暖暖的。
lines.en: The sun warms the fur along my back.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子伸进麦秆之间。
lines.en: I push my nose between the wheat stalks.

lines.zh: 远处有猫头鹰，我不动。
lines.en: An owl calls far off, and I do not move.

lines.zh: 我咬着尾巴尖，咬着玩。
lines.en: I nibble the tip of my tail for fun.

lines.zh: 恶地的风带着土味吹过来。
lines.en: The badlands wind arrives tasting of dust.

lines.zh: 我打了个呵欠，牙很小。
lines.en: I yawn, and my teeth are very small.

lines.zh: 我数着麦穗，数到一半就睡了。
lines.en: I count the wheat ears and fall asleep halfway.

lines.zh: 我的长影子在田里慢慢移。
lines.en: My long shadow creeps across the field.

lines.zh: 我用后爪挠耳根，挠得直眯眼。
lines.en: I scratch behind my ear with a hind claw, eyes shut.

lines.zh: 一只甲虫爬过，我看了很久。
lines.en: A beetle crawls by and I watch it a long while.

lines.zh: 我把耳朵贴在地上，听远处。
lines.en: I press an ear to the ground and listen far off.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖毛，抖下一层土。
lines.en: I shake my fur and a layer of dust falls off.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子拉得很长。
lines.en: I look up at you, my neck stretching long.

lines.zh: 你的影子落下来，我闻了闻。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on me and I sniff it.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在两边，看得见你后面。
lines.en: My eyes sit on the sides; I see behind you.

lines.zh: 你蹲下，我才把身体放低。
lines.en: You crouch, and only then do I lower myself.

lines.zh: 我把头歪到一边，从头到脚看你。
lines.en: I tilt my head and look you over head to foot.

lines.zh: 你手上没有吃的，我依旧看着。
lines.en: No food in your hands, and still I watch.

lines.zh: 胡须动了两下，我在记你的味。
lines.en: My whiskers twitch twice; I am learning your smell.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，尾巴尖在摆。
lines.en: I stand still, only my tail tip moving.

lines.zh: 你这么高，我以前没见过。
lines.en: You are this tall; I have not seen your like.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，没有退开。
lines.en: I blink slowly and do not back away.

lines.zh: 你把灯举高，我的眼睛缩了一下。
lines.en: You raise the lamp and my pupils shrink.

lines.zh: 我看着你的脚，那里离我最近。
lines.en: I watch your feet; they are nearest to me.

lines.zh: 风把你的气味送过来，我记住了。
lines.en: The wind brings your scent and I remember it.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，只是还不熟。
lines.en: I am not afraid of you, only unacquainted.

lines.zh: 你打中我的肋骨，很细很脆。
lines.en: You hit my ribs; they are thin and brittle.

lines.zh: 我尖叫了一声，声音比身体大。
lines.en: I squeal, and the sound is bigger than I am.

lines.zh: 我翻过身，尾巴抽在你手上。
lines.en: I roll over and my tail whips your hand.

lines.zh: 血从耳朵后面流下来。
lines.en: Blood runs down from behind my ear.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，又立刻弹开。
lines.en: I curl up, then spring away at once.

lines.zh: 你打中我，我的小步全乱了。
lines.en: You hit me and my quick little steps scatter.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条后腿跑了两步。
lines.en: I drag a hind leg for two steps.

lines.zh: 你踩住我的尾巴，我咬你鞋。
lines.en: You pin my tail, so I bite your shoe.

lines.zh: 我疼得直抖，毛全炸开了。
lines.en: I tremble so hard my fur stands on end.

lines.zh: 我退进麦子里，只露出眼睛。
lines.en: I back into the wheat with only my eyes showing.

lines.zh: 你手里的种子，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the seeds in your hand.

lines.zh: 我靠近一步，又停住。
lines.en: I take one step closer and stop.

lines.zh: 麦粒撒在地上，我才肯低头。
lines.en: Only when the grain is on the ground do I lower my head.

lines.zh: 你动一下，我就退半步。
lines.en: You move, and I retreat half a step.

lines.zh: 我不从手上吃东西。
lines.en: I do not eat from a hand.

lines.zh: 你蹲得很低，这让我放心。
lines.en: You crouch low, and that puts me at ease.

lines.zh: 我咬着麦粒，眼睛还看着你。
lines.en: I nibble the grain with one eye on you.

lines.zh: 你把种子放在石头上，走开。
lines.en: You set the seeds on a stone and walk away.

lines.zh: 香味很淡，我的鼻子很灵。
lines.en: The smell is faint; my nose is keen.

lines.zh: 吃一口，我就往后退一寸。
lines.en: One bite, and I retreat an inch.

lines.zh: 你的靴子碰到我，我弹了一下。
lines.en: Your boot touches me and I spring away.

lines.zh: 我被撞得转身，尾巴甩起来。
lines.en: Knocked about, I spin and my tail whips out.

lines.zh: 我很轻，撞上来像碰到草。
lines.en: I am light; bumping me is like touching grass.

lines.zh: 我压着尾巴从你腿间钻过去。
lines.en: I duck between your legs, tail pressed down.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的影子，我先跳开。
lines.en: You step on my shadow and I leap first.

lines.zh: 相撞时我听见骨头很细。
lines.en: On contact I hear how thin my own bones are.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的裤脚，又松开。
lines.en: I catch your trouser leg and let go at once.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，麦子倒了一片。
lines.en: We collide and a patch of wheat goes down.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖毛，把土抖到一边。
lines.en: I shake my fur and the dust flies off.

lines.zh: 你退开，我才把背放低。
lines.en: You step back, and then I lower my back.

lines.zh: 我们并排坐着，尾巴交在一起。
lines.en: We sit side by side, tails crossed.

lines.zh: 它比我矮半个头，耳朵更长。
lines.en: It stands half a head shorter, ears longer.

lines.zh: 我们互相啃着对方颈后的毛。
lines.en: We nibble the fur at each other's necks.

lines.zh: 它在麦田里等我，我跑过去。
lines.en: It waits in the wheat, and I run to it.

lines.zh: 我们的胡须一碰就分开。
lines.en: Our whiskers touch once and part.

lines.zh: 田埂下有个洞，我们一起钻。
lines.en: There is a burrow under the ridge; we go in together.

lines.zh: 它咬我的耳朵，很轻。
lines.en: It nibbles my ear, very gently.

lines.zh: 夜里我们轮流听外面的动静。
lines.en: At night we take turns listening outside.

lines.zh: 我把最软的草铺进洞里。
lines.en: I line the burrow with the softest grass.

lines.zh: 天亮了，我们一起去看麦子。
lines.en: At dawn we go and check the wheat together.

lines.zh: 我叼起麦粒，腮帮子鼓起来。
lines.en: I pick up a grain and my cheek bulges.

lines.zh: 东西太重，我拖着走两步。
lines.en: Too heavy, so I drag it two steps.

lines.zh: 你掉的种子，我一颗颗捡。
lines.en: I gather the seeds you dropped, one by one.

lines.zh: 我用前爪捧住，怕它滚掉。
lines.en: I cup it in my forepaws so it cannot roll.

lines.zh: 地上的布片，我拖进洞里。
lines.en: I drag the cloth scrap into my burrow.

lines.zh: 我咬住绳头，往后拉。
lines.en: I take the rope's end and pull backward.

lines.zh: 小东西塞进腮里，大的不行。
lines.en: Small things fit in my cheeks; big ones do not.

lines.zh: 我捡了一块亮石头，放着玩。
lines.en: I pick up a shiny stone to play with.

lines.zh: 你的东西我不要，只要种子。
lines.en: I do not want your things, only seeds.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴卷住它，慢慢拖走。
lines.en: I curl my tail around it and drag it away.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了麦子，我盯上你了。
lines.en: You crushed the wheat, so I have my eye on you.

lines.zh: 你靠近洞口，我先竖起耳朵。
lines.en: You near the burrow and my ears go up first.

lines.zh: 我在田埂上看着你弯腰。
lines.en: From the field ridge I watch you bend down.

lines.zh: 你拿了我的麦穗，我记得。
lines.en: You took my wheat ear, and I remember.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，尾巴绷直了。
lines.en: I flatten down and my tail goes stiff.

lines.zh: 风把你的味道送到我这边。
lines.en: The wind brings your smell over to me.

lines.zh: 你走得太慢，我决定跟上去。
lines.en: You walk too slowly; I decide to follow.

lines.zh: 我不叫，只用眼睛锁住你。
lines.en: I make no sound; my eyes alone hold you.

lines.zh: 你挡在洞口和我之间。
lines.en: You stand between me and my burrow.

lines.zh: 这片麦田我熟，你不熟。
lines.en: I know this wheat field; you do not.

lines.zh: 我刨了两下土，那是记号。
lines.en: I paw the soil twice; that is my mark.

lines.zh: 你身上有别的鼠味。
lines.en: You carry the smell of another mouse.

lines.zh: 我在恶地的石缝里选中了你。
lines.en: In a badlands crevice I settle on you.

lines.zh: 从这一眼起，我不打算放过你。
lines.en: From this look on, I do not mean to let you go.

lines.zh: 我贴着田埂跑，比你快半拍。
lines.en: I run along the ridge, half a beat ahead.

lines.zh: 你回头看，我已经在另一头。
lines.en: You look back and I am already at the other end.

lines.zh: 我从麦子底下钻，麦穗不动。
lines.en: I slip under the wheat without stirring it.

lines.zh: 你踩过的地方，我踩着追。
lines.en: I step where you stepped and follow.

lines.zh: 我的长尾巴帮我转弯。
lines.en: My long tail swings me through the turns.

lines.zh: 你往村里跑，我抄近路穿田。
lines.en: You run for the village; I cut across the field.

lines.zh: 我不急着咬，我想先看清你。
lines.en: I do not bite yet; I want a clear look at you.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我立刻换了个方向。
lines.en: You raise a hand and I switch direction at once.

lines.zh: 恶地的石堆挡你，我绕过去。
lines.en: The badlands rocks slow you; I go around.

lines.zh: 我的影子在你脚边晃。
lines.en: My shadow sways at your feet.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过地面，我跟着你。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the ground; I follow you.

lines.zh: 我在等你停下，停下最好抓。
lines.en: I wait for you to stop; stopped prey is easiest.

lines.zh: 你听见细碎的脚步，那就是我。
lines.en: Those tiny steps you hear are mine.

lines.zh: 麦子一倒，你就知道我在哪。
lines.en: When the wheat falls, you know where I am.

lines.zh: 我绕到石堆背面，从那边过来。
lines.en: I circle behind the rocks and come from there.

lines.zh: 我扑上去咬住你的手指。
lines.en: I leap and bite down on your finger.

lines.zh: 我的门牙细，咬进皮里却很深。
lines.en: My front teeth are fine, yet they sink deep.

lines.zh: 我抓你的手背，抓出几道。
lines.en: I rake your hand and leave red lines.

lines.zh: 你被我一撞，退进麦子里。
lines.en: My lunge knocks you back into the wheat.

lines.zh: 我咬完就跳开，不站在原地。
lines.en: I bite and leap away, never staying put.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴缠你的脚踝。
lines.en: I loop my tail around your ankle.

lines.zh: 这一口是冲你的袖口去的。
lines.en: That bite was aimed at your sleeve.

lines.zh: 你甩手，我挂在你袖子上。
lines.en: You shake your arm and I hang on the sleeve.

lines.zh: 我落地时，麦秆只轻轻一动。
lines.en: When I land, the wheat stirs only slightly.

lines.zh: 咬一口就够，我只要你怕。
lines.en: One bite is enough; I want you afraid.

lines.zh: 我从麦田的土里拱出来。
lines.en: I push up out of the field soil.

lines.zh: 草比我高的时候，我出生了。
lines.en: I was born when the grass stood taller than me.

lines.zh: 恶地的石头下面，我睁开眼。
lines.en: Under a badlands stone I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴先长出来，比身体长。
lines.en: My tail grew first, longer than my body.

lines.zh: 平原的露水把我身上打湿。
lines.en: Plains dew soaks my fur through.

lines.zh: 我站起来，麦秆在我旁边摇。
lines.en: I stand up and the wheat sways beside me.

lines.zh: 这一片田只养得起我一只。
lines.en: This field can only feed one of me.

lines.zh: 我第一次听见风穿过麦子。
lines.en: I hear wind in the wheat for the first time.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵动了，远处有人来。
lines.en: My ears twitch; someone is coming from far off.

lines.zh: 土很松，我一钻就出来了。
lines.en: The soil was loose; one push and I was out.

lines.zh: 我在洞口坐了一会，才敢走远。
lines.en: I sit at the burrow a while before going far.

lines.zh: 晨光里，影子比田埂还长。
lines.en: In the morning light my shadow outruns the ridge.

lines.zh: 我把第一根麦穗咬断了。
lines.en: I bit through my first wheat ear.

lines.zh: 这地方安静，适合长身体。
lines.en: It is quiet here, good for growing.

lines.zh: 火一碰毛就卷起来，我往土里钻。
lines.en: My fur curls at one touch of fire; I dig for soil.

lines.zh: 从田埂摔下去，我落地滚两圈。
lines.en: I fall off the ridge and roll twice on landing.

lines.zh: 水进了鼻子，我四爪乱抓。
lines.en: Water fills my nose and all four paws claw.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，麦子压在身上。
lines.en: The blast flips me and wheat falls across my body.

lines.zh: 箭穿过耳朵，钉在麦秆上。
lines.en: An arrow clips my ear and pins itself in a stalk.

lines.zh: 光罩住我，我的腿不听使唤。
lines.en: Light wraps me and my legs stop obeying.

lines.zh: 麦子吃完了，肚子贴着背。
lines.en: The wheat is gone and my belly meets my spine.

lines.zh: 雷落在我旁边，我半天听不见。
lines.en: Lightning lands beside me and I go deaf for a while.

lines.zh: 底下空了，我的尾巴还在抓。
lines.en: Nothing below, and my tail still grasps at air.
